messages:
emma-sales: Customer (FinData) asked for a 6-week POC. Must have VPC + customer KMS, audit logs, and acceptance criteria by week 6. Targets: p95 <200ms for short prompts, cost target ~$400/1M tokens. They can provide 2500 labeled prompts.

noah-eng: Traffic profile? That will determine Dedicated sizing and batching.

emma-sales: They expect ~45 qps steady, spikes to ~200 qps during nightly scoring windows. Typical prompt <=128 tokens.

rachel-solutions: Draft acceptance criteria: 95%+ on 100 critical labeled prompts; p95 <200ms at 45 qps sustained; operating cost <=$400/1M tokens; VPC+KMS verified; <60s total downtime during acceptance.

leo-ml: I'll split their 2500 into train/eval and reserve 100 for critical checks. We'll run our eval harness and report accuracy + domain metric. Can they send labels for the 100?

ops-ari: Recommend Dedicated reserved pool for predictable throughput. Need PS for VPC peering and KMS onboarding. Runbook: canary rollout, monitor token rate, route to hosted fallback if pool >90% utilized.

sec-bot: Attach sec questionnaire v3: https://redwood.internal/sec/q-template. KMS checklist: key ARN, rotation policy, IAM principals.

noah-eng: Model suggestion: open-llm-7b q4 on A10-like nodes — expected p95 ~130-170ms for short prompts. Q8 variant lowers latency but increases cost; will quantify. Add small cURL snippet for eval in doc.

emma-sales: Procurement asks for predictable pricing. Solutions: (A) weekly reserved commit for POC with a discount, (B) PAYG with burst surcharge. Rachel, can you draft a one-pager (acceptance checklist + pricing + onboarding steps) by tomorrow morning?

rachel-solutions: On it. Meeting 9am PST to finalize.

leo-ml: Quick pilot run (200 prompts): accuracy 94%, p95 152ms on q4; cost estimate ~$370/1M tokens. Will refine after full run.
